title: Long vowels ai/ee/igh/oa/oo
examples: Teacher, what is the difference between 'ai' and 'a'?
Can you give me more words with the 'ee' sound?
How do I know if I need 'igh' or 'i'?

explain.say: Today we learn about long vowel sounds. These sounds are different from short sounds. We will look at special letter groups that make one long sound.
A digraph is two letters making one sound. For example, 'ai' makes the long 'a' sound like in rain. Say 'rain' with me.
Another common digraph is 'ee' for the long 'e' sound. Think of the word 'see'. The 'ee' makes the sound you hear.
A trigraph uses three letters for one sound. 'igh' makes the long 'i' sound like in high. Can you say 'high'?
We also see 'oa' for the long 'o' sound, like in boat. And 'oo' for the long 'u' sound, like in moon. These groups help us read.

draw.text: oa = long o; oo = long u

faq.a: A digraph is when two letters work together to make just one sound. It is a team of two letters.
asks: Are two letters always a team?

faq.q: How do I know if a vowel sound is long or short?
faq.a: The short sound is quick, like in 'cat'. The long sound says its name, like in 'cake'.
asks: What is the difference between short and long?
Does the letter name help me know the sound?

faq.q: Do all long vowels use two letters?
faq.a: No, some use two letters like 'ai', and some use three letters like 'igh'.
asks: Must long vowels have two letters?
Can three letters make one sound?

faq.a: Usually, yes, 'oa' makes the long 'o' sound, like in boat. But we must still practice reading.
asks: Does 'oa' always mean the same thing?

faq.a: The 'oo' sound is long like in moon. It makes the sound you hear when you say 'moon'.

facts: A digraph uses two letters to make one sound.
The long vowel sound is the name of the vowel, like 'a' in 'cake'.

quiz.say: Which spelling makes the long 'a' sound in the word rain?
quiz.why: The letters 'ai' together make the long 'a' sound, like in rain.

wrong.1: This is the short 'a' sound, like in ant.
wrong.2: While 'ay' can make the long 'a' sound, 'ai' is the digraph we are learning today.
wrong.3: This is a single letter and does not form the correct digraph.

quiz.say: Which spelling makes the long 'e' sound in the word tree?
quiz.why: The letters 'ee' together make the long 'e' sound, like in tree.

wrong.0: This is the short 'i' sound, like in pig.
wrong.1: This is not a standard spelling pattern.
wrong.3: While 'ea' can make the long 'e' sound, 'ee' is the specific digraph we are focusing on.

quiz.say: Which spelling makes the long 'o' sound in the word boat?
quiz.why: The letters 'oa' together make the long 'o' sound, like in boat.

wrong.0: While 'ow' can make the long 'o' sound, 'oa' is the digraph we are learning today.
wrong.1: This is a single letter and does not form the correct digraph.
wrong.3: This is the short 'o' sound, like in pot.
